Add enhanced card database editor with validation and browser

Upgrade CardDatabaseEditor with Odin Inspector-based UI featuring:

Validation System:
- Check for empty card names, costs, and effects
- Detailed validation reports with issue summaries
- Dialog and console output for easy navigation

Statistics View:
- Visual progress bars for card type distribution
- Rarity breakdown with percentages
- Notable cards section highlighting highest damage, composure,
  most effects, and cheapest cards
- Clickable card names for quick navigation

Card Browser View:
- Search filter by card name
- Filter by card type (Diplomacy, Hostility, Manipulate)
- Filter by rarity (Basic, Enhanced, Rare)
- Multi-criteria sorting:
  - Name, Damage, Composure, Effects count, Cost, Type, Rarity
  - Toggle ascending/descending order
- Scrollable card list with alternating row colors
- Color-coded type and rarity badges
- At-a-glance stats (AP cost, effect count, damage, composure)
- Click any card to select and ping in project

Technical improvements:
- Pure Rect-based drawing to prevent GUI stack errors
- Pre-calculated values to avoid conditional GUI calls
- Proper Event.current.type checking for repaint operations
